subject.title: feat(ui): Labs settings page for experimental feature toggles

question: Should Settings → Labs become the canonical Control UI surface for persistent experimental feature gates, beginning with Code Mode?
rationale: The implementation creates a new globally navigable product surface and a registry intended to host future experimental settings; correctness fixes alone cannot establish that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Code Mode Labs page
options.body: Keep the page scoped to the existing Code Mode gate, land it only after stale-snapshot recovery and live Gateway proof are supplied.

options.title: Defer Labs until the broader experimental-settings direction is approved
options.body: Keep Code Mode discoverable through its existing documentation and configuration while the Swarm and Labs product shape is decided together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Code Mode Labs page
recommendation.body: Keep the page scoped to the existing Code Mode gate, land it only after stale-snapshot recovery and live Gateway proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the connected Swarm proposal that defines Labs as the experimental-toggle surface.
